newsitem.title: USA: Fla. board approves Miami five-year bailout plan.
newsitem.headline: Fla. board approves Miami five-year bailout plan.

text.p: A state-appointed oversight board on Monday unanimously approved the city of Miami's bailout plan that balances the city's budget through 2002.
"We're now on a track for a great happy ending for the city of Miami," Lieutenant Gov. Buddy MacKay said. MacKay chairs the state oversight board.

The budget plan uses a new fire district tax, operating efficiencies, and cuts in services to balance the budget. Gov. Lawton Chiles appointed the board in December to steer Miami's recovery from a $68 million deficit for fiscal 1997.
